title: Talondoʼ language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sulawesi, Indonesia
extract: Talondoʼ is an endangered Austronesian language spoken in West Sulawesi, Indonesia. Its speakers live in Talondo Kondo village in Mamuju Regency and are ethnically referred to as the Talondo’ people.
